title: Weekend Catch-Up Sleep
subtitle: Practical guidance, tradeoffs, and evidence related to weekend catch-up sleep.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports acute benefits of weekend catch-up sleep in restoring alertness and mood, while moderate emerging evidence indicates incomplete recovery from chronic sleep restriction and potential circadian risks. Evidence limitations include primarily short-term studies and observational designs for long-term health outcomes.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
